# Nybble Optional Mesh References

No Nybble STL files are bundled in this repository yet.

The renderer is prepared for optional mesh attachments, but the procedural fallback body is the default and must remain sufficient. Candidate attachment points are:

| Caz rig link | Candidate source piece | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `head` | head shell | Not bundled, license pending |
| `left-ear`, `right-ear` | ear shells | Not bundled, license pending |
| `torso`, `chest` | body plates | Not bundled, license pending |
| leg links | thigh and shank pieces | Not bundled, license pending |
| `tail-base`, `tail-tip` | tail segments | Not bundled, license pending |

Before any STL is committed, record the upstream URL, retrieval date, license text, scale, orientation, conversion command, and the generated app-friendly asset path.
